title: MLS system audit #4 — coverage-driven sweep of every remaining module
method: inventoried all 46 modules by LOC vs test references to find genuinely untouched code, rather than choosing areas by intuition; then exercised each thin module functionally.
orchestration: all 5 MLS scheduler jobs invoked and run clean (mls_stats_job ingested 20 matches + mapped 2 players live). All 7 WC26/legacy jobs run clean too.

investigated_and_cleared.INTEGRITY_FAILED on 4 locks: STALE ARTIFACTS, not a defect — those locks were captured 2026-07-23 in a DB with 0 approval decisions, predating the V9 approval feature. The F9 gate now refuses to create a canonical lock without an approved decision, and prod holds decision 182. A test already asserts a FRESH lock passes all_pass incl. approval-decision reference + engine signature; still green after today changes.
investigated_and_cleared.lock policy v2 vs the audit: audit checks snapshot_policy_version for PRESENCE (bool), not a pinned string, so bumping mls-lock-v1 -> v2 does not break lock integrity checks
investigated_and_cleared.bracket resolver alert spam: IDEMPOTENT — 8 alerts on a fresh DB run, 0 on the second run; no repeat announcements in prod
investigated_and_cleared.model_cache (0 test refs): not dead code — used in 8 call sites; process-local dict, bounded by market count
investigated_and_cleared.paper signals rejected NOT_EXECUTION_REA: pre-fix artifacts from the old lock policy; notably one carried net_edge +0.0241 and WOULD have filled, confirming the v2 fix unblocks real execution

passed.observability.metrics / risk.assess / sl: all return well-formed reports; slate qualification invariants all true (no duplicate canonical locks, no post-kickoff locks, every fixture classified)
passed.frontend pages: /bet-suggester?league=mls, /bet-suggester, /bet-suggester/bots all render with ZERO console errors
passed.settlement: win/loss/draw + exact Decimal P&L verified in round 3

remaining_untestable: settlement against a REAL completed fixture, and the in-play live path under an actual live match — both only exercisable once Saturday matches kick off and resolve.
